ios.desc:
Trelleborg’s “Unit and Hardness Converter” converts a comprehensive list of units (incl. currencies) in an easy way. 
In addition, the app has a set of other useful features on board, like timezone conversion, percentage calculations, a running pace calculator and more

What our users say: 
“Have been using it forever, never tried other converter as this one does the job perfectly” - Lazareth_fr

“Fabulous resource, but also a functional masterpiece!” -Otto. 
 
“This is needed by all engineers. So simple and easy to use” -JLa03. 
 
FEATURES
• Easy-to-use interface 
• Currency converter with in-app exchange rate update functionality 
• Over 300 engineering and scientific conversion units in 32 categories 
• Hardness converter with 16 conversion tables based on ASTM E140-07 and ISO-18265 for quick conversion between different scales 
• Video library: features the extensive Trelleborg Sealing Solutions YouTube library
• Toggle between units
• Switch between dark and white theme
• Conversion history log
• Create favorite lists
• Standard calculator integrated with unit converter


DIMENSIONS 
• Area 
• Currency 
• Current 
• Data 
• Density 
• Distance 
• Dynamic Viscosity 
• Energy 
• Force 
• Frequency 
• Kinematic Viscosity 
• Moment of inertia 
• Power 
• Prefixes 
• Pressure 
• Speed 
• Strength 
• Temperature 
• Time 
• Torque 
• Volume 
• Weight
• Fuel Consumption
• Glucose
• Vacuum
• Numbers
• Illumination
• Radioactivity
• Radiation (absorbed)
• Angles
• Volume Flow Rate
• Calorie
• Metric Prefixes
• Typography
• Electric Charge

OTHER MISCELLANEOUS CATEGORIES
• Timezone conversion 
• Clothing sizes / Shoe sizes 
• International power plugs
• Running pace calculator
• Percentage calculator
• Pace
• Hex, Binary, Decimal
• BMI (metric/inch)

HARDNESS SCALES INCLUDED
• Rockwell (HRC, HRA, HRD, HRF, HRG, HRE, HR-15-N, HR-30N, HR-45-N, HR45-T, HR-15T, HR-30T, HR45-T) 
• Brinell (HBW, HBS) 
• Vickers (HV, 
• Knoop (HK) 
 
The app is available in English, German and Chinese languages.
Download now or contact us with any questions.
